title: Nickel Supply Chain Visibility
thesis: Snowflake tracks nickel from mine face to battery cathode — Dynamic Tables maintain real-time material flow, ML.FORECAST projects processing output, and Iceberg shares certified supply chain data with EV OEMs

talking_points: Forty mines feeding 12 processing plants producing battery-grade nickel for global EV OEMs.
Monthly output at 92% of plan — HPAL Plant 2 in Morowali experiencing acid supply constraints.
Delivery compliance at 96.3% — two contracts flagged for potential shortfall next quarter.
show: Point at 92% output vs plan KPI
tabs.call_out: 92% of plan — HPAL Plant 2 bottleneck, 2 contracts at risk

transition.line: Let's drill into the material flow to see where nickel is getting stuck.

talking_points: 80,000 material movements tracked from mine face to battery-grade product.
Processing yield averaging 87% for RKEF, 91% for HPAL — both within spec.
Ore grade from Morowali mines trending down 0.3% Ni — affecting HPAL feed quality.
show: Show Sankey diagram of material flow
Point at yield percentages by process
tabs.call_out: Grade declining 0.3% Ni at Morowali — feed quality impact on HPAL

transition.line: Grade variance is the issue. Let's see what ML projects for output.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST projects production output per plant 30 days forward.
HPAL Plant 2 projected to recover to 95% capacity after acid supply normalizes.
Grade anomaly detection flagged 3 mines with unusual variance — potential contamination.
show: Show production forecast chart by plant
Point at HPAL Plant 2 recovery curve
tabs.call_out: ML projects HPAL recovery in 2 weeks — but 3 mines flagged for grade anomaly

transition.line: Now let the VP ask about delivery commitments.

talking_points: Bambang asks: 'What's our delivery compliance rate for EV OEM contracts?'
Cortex Analyst queries delivery data — returns 96.3% with 2 contracts at risk.
Follow-up: 'What are our options if HPAL Plant 2 continues underperforming?' — agent assesses alternatives.
show: Switch to advisory mode for mitigation
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: supply chain analytics + strategic advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, open Iceberg for buyers.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services in the dual-build architecture.
Iceberg enables EV OEMs to verify supply chain provenance via Athena.
Indonesia holds 22% of global nickel reserves. This tracks 40 mines to battery-grade product.
tabs.call_out: One platform, mine-to-battery traceability, open Iceberg for buyers

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for nickel supply chains.
